title: Fantasy Foosball Weekly: Year 8, Week 8 Preview
subtitle: With six playoff spots available, modeled postseason chances put pressure on the middle and lower ranks.

playoffModel.description: Seeded Monte Carlo estimate using current record, scoring strength and remaining Sleeper schedule.

matchups.headline: Payton faces a must-protect position against Brae
matchups.paragraph: Payton’s I ♥️ Big Tet-Tees enters Week 8 ranked fourth at 4-3, with an 88.9% modeled playoff chance. A win raises that figure to 91.2%, while a loss drops it to 75.8%, a 15.4-point swing. Brae’s Ogles Outlaws are 0-7 and ranked 12th; the model gives them no playoff chance before or after either result. The matchup offers Payton a chance to preserve a strong position, while Brae is seeking a first win.

matchups.headline: Andy’s strong position meets Kade’s urgent climb
matchups.paragraph: Andy’s Long dong silvers hold second place at 6-1, and the model gives them a 92.6% playoff chance. A win lifts that to 97.6%; a loss lowers it to 85.6%, a 12-point swing. Kade’s CheesusJesus is ranked eighth at 3-4, with only a 9.4% modeled playoff chance. That chance rises to 17.1% with a win and falls to 4.1% with a loss, making this a meaningful opportunity for Kade.

matchups.headline: Kane can gain ground, but Alex is already favored by the model
matchups.paragraph: Kane’s Blueballs are ranked sixth at 4-3, carrying an 85.7% modeled playoff chance into a matchup with Alex. A win moves Kane to 94.3%, while a loss leaves 79.7%, a 14.6-point swing. Alex’s I love big TD’s is third at 5-2, and the model gives the defending 2025 champion a 98.9% playoff chance. The result barely shifts Alex’s outlook: 99.7% with a win and 97.8% with a loss.

teamA.leagueLore: 2019 inaugural champion. League Public Enemy. Nickname: King of Dogshit Trades.

matchups.headline: Parker and Cooper meet with little margin below the line
matchups.paragraph: Parker’s My BallDak hurts and Cooper’s Jack MeHoff are both 2-5, ranked 10th and 11th, respectively. Parker’s modeled playoff chance is 26.1%, rising to 30.8% with a win but dropping to 10.1% with a loss—a 20.7-point swing. Cooper, the 2022 champion, has only a 0.4% chance; a win raises it to 1.3%, while a loss reduces it to 0.1%. Parker has considerably more modeled leverage.

matchups.headline: CJ’s fifth-ranked team stands between Joey and a late push
matchups.paragraph: Joey’s Off Constantly is 3-4 and ranked seventh, with a 4.7% modeled playoff chance. A win raises that figure to 11.3%, while a loss lowers it to 2%, a 9.3-point swing. CJ’s cjbroadway23 enters at 4-3 in fifth place, and the model gives CJ an 85.9% playoff chance. That outlook reaches 90.9% with a win and falls to 73.9% with a loss, creating the matchup’s larger modeled swing.

matchups.headline: Evan’s top-ranked Bonnie Blue 42 can nearly lock in its outlook
matchups.paragraph: Evan’s Bonnie Blue 42 leads the league at 6-1, and the model gives the 2023 champion a 99.9% playoff chance. A win raises that to 100%, while a loss still leaves 99.7%, just a 0.3-point swing. Kohlt’s team, kohlt, is ranked ninth at 3-4 with a 7.4% modeled playoff chance. A win would lift Kohlt to 18.2%, but a loss drops the chance to 4.8%, making this far more consequential for Kohlt.
